ctenidium: A respiratory system, in the form of a comb, in some molluscs
ctenoid: Having a toothed margin, usually fish scales
ctenophoran: Any comb jelly of the phylum Ctenophora
ctenophore: Any of various marine animals of the phylum Ctenophora, having lucent, mucilaginous bodies bearing eight rows of comblike cilia used for swimming.
